items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: Doctor MacDonald knows you. He comes into Ryan's all the time and everything. He says, so you get him to look after Marge.

ctx.x: Oh yes, my doctor, Doctor MacDonald.
Doctor MacDonald was the last one.
That was Peewee Russel's doctor. He's the one operated on me.
